title: Sleepy lion cub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='30' fill='#c97a1e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#f0a54a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- mane fluff bumps -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='34' r='8' fill='#d98a2b'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='34' r='8' fill='#d98a2b'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='60' r='8' fill='#d98a2b'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='60' r='8' fill='#d98a2b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='8' fill='#d98a2b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='8' fill='#d98a2b'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='21' fill='#f6c98a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='7' fill='#f6c98a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='7' fill='#f6c98a'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#e8a95e'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#e8a95e'/>
  <!-- sleepy eyes: closed arcs -->
  <path d='M37 44 q5 5 10 0' fill='none' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 44 q5 5 10 0' fill='none' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#fbe2b8'/>
  <path d='M46 52 q4 4 8 0' fill='none' stroke='#a5652a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 55 v3' stroke='#a5652a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 58 q-3 3 -5 1' fill='none' stroke='#a5652a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 58 q3 3 5 1' fill='none' stroke='#a5652a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='53' r='3.5' fill='#f4a0a0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='53' r='3.5' fill='#f4a0a0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- sleepy zzz -->
  <path d='M74 20 h7 l-7 7 h7' fill='none' stroke='#9ad0f0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M80 10 h5 l-5 5 h5' fill='none' stroke='#9ad0f0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
